note: Reviewed per record against the raw box export of 2026-10-18 (OPAX_ROSTER_ACCEPT=1 export_people.sh). Read scripts/roster_accept.py.

hansard-growth.reason: Hansard loaded since the shipped baseline (meta.generated 2026-10-04): nightly sittings, the federal missing-day backfill (Senate 2019-2025, House 2022-2025: docs/reports/2026-10-13-federal-hansard-backfill.md) and per-turn speaker attribution (docs/operations/2026-10-12-speaker-attribution-repair.md). Counts and witness rows only rise, a first year moves no earlier than 2019, a last year only later, only committee chambers are added.

presiding-officer.reason: Presiding-officer turns are chair turns since the speaker attribution repair (docs/operations/2026-10-12-speaker-attribution-repair.md: speaker_type=chair, no personal person_id), so the count of the officer's own speeches falls and the last own speech can be earlier.

witness-partition.reason: The production SQL export partitions a majority-witness print (docs/ROSTER-WITNESS-SPLIT.md, scripts/export_parliamentarians.py): the separated testimony carries counts only, no MP name, id, party or seat; `speeches` is the print's own non-witness count, `transcript` keeps the whole aggregate. Accepted only where the aggregate is conserved or rises and no identity field moves.

reorder.reason: The same chambers or states in a new order (the export orders by row count).

aph-handbook.reason: Parliamentary Handbook API (APH; facts of office, attributed), fetched 2026-10-18 with the OPAXBot user agent, joined to the OPAX pid through OpenAustralia's people.csv APH id (pid = 10000 + person count).

state-evidence.reason: The repo's reviewed dated rosters (scripts/roster_state_evidence.json, reviewed 2026-10-06): the member, chamber and seat are in the cited snapshot, so the seat basis reads as dated. Only the basis wording changes.

record-evidence.reason: The record's own identity_evidence carries a dated term for the seat, so the seat basis reads as dated. Only the basis wording changes.
